biological_replicate.evidence: inferred: All DEPs were, again, used for GO enrichment with the R package clusterProfiler (v4.4.4) and org.Mm.eg.db (v3.15.0). Following GO enrichment, DEPs found in both the PTE+ and PTE− groups of the hippocampus were plotted on a chord plot utilizing the GOplot (v1.0.2) package in R. Using the R packages ggfortify (v0.4.16) and ggplot2 (v3.4.3), generated 2D PCA plots were consistently clustered into sham, PTE+, and PTE− animals, thus males and females were collapsed in each group (Supplementary Figure S1). Male mice were primarily utilized for proteomics, except for two female mice in the PTE+ group.
